# openmetadata_ingestion_pipeline (Data Source)

Fetches an OpenMetadata Ingestion Pipeline (an "agent" in the OpenMetadata 2.x UI) by its fully qualified name (service.pipeline). The `sourceConfig` is not returned.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up an ingestion pipeline by its fully qualified name (<service>.<pipeline>).
# The sourceConfig is not returned.
data "openmetadata_ingestion_pipeline" "postgres_metadata" {
  name = "ProductionPostgres.postgres_metadata"
}

output "pipeline_id" {
  value = data.openmetadata_ingestion_pipeline.postgres_metadata.id
}

output "pipeline_type" {
  value = data.openmetadata_ingestion_pipeline.postgres_metadata.pipeline_type
}

output "pipeline_schedule" {
  value = data.openmetadata_ingestion_pipeline.postgres_metadata.airflow_config.schedule_interval
}

output "pipeline_deployed" {
  value = data.openmetadata_ingestion_pipeline.postgres_metadata.deployed
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Fully qualified name of the pipeline, e.g. "my_service.my_pipeline".

### Read-Only

- `airflow_config` (Attributes) Scheduling and runtime settings of the pipeline. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--airflow_config))
- `deployed` (Boolean) True once the pipeline has been deployed.
- `description` (String) Description of the pipeline.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable display name.
- `domains` (List of String) Fully qualified names of the domains this pipeline belongs to.
- `enable_streamable_logs` (Boolean) Whether logs are streamed to the server.
- `enabled` (Boolean) False if the pipeline is paused.
- `fully_qualified_name` (String) Fully qualified name.
- `id` (String) UUID of the ingestion pipeline.
- `logger_level` (String) Logging level of the workflow.
- `owners` (Attributes List) Owners of this pipeline. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--owners))
- `pipeline_type` (String) Workflow type (metadata, usage, lineage, profiler, ...).
- `raise_on_error` (Boolean) Whether processing errors fail the workflow.
- `service` (Attributes) The entity the pipeline ingests from. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--service))

<a id="nestedatt--airflow_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `airflow_config`

Read-Only:

- `concurrency` (Number) Concurrency of the pipeline.
- `email` (String) Email notified about the workflow status.
- `max_active_runs` (Number) Maximum number of active runs.
- `pause_pipeline` (Boolean) Whether the pipeline is paused once deployed.
- `pipeline_catchup` (Boolean) Whether past executions are run.
- `pipeline_timezone` (String) Timezone of the schedule.
- `retries` (Number) Number of retries in case of failure.
- `retry_delay` (Number) Delay between retries, in seconds.
- `schedule_interval` (String) Schedule in cron format.
- `workflow_timeout` (Number) Workflow timeout, in seconds.


<a id="nestedatt--owners"></a>
### Nested Schema for `owners`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) UUID of the owner entity.
- `type` (String) Type of the owner (user or team).


<a id="nestedatt--service"></a>
### Nested Schema for `service`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Fully qualified name of the service.
- `type` (String) Entity type of the service.
